t: 尼克福罗斯二世被加冕为拜占庭帝国皇帝,发誓要保护前皇帝罗马诺斯二世的两个儿子,他们已经加冕为同…
te: Nikephoros II Phokas is crowned emperor of the Byzantine Empire, swearing to protect the two sons of the previous emper…
dz: 尼克福罗斯二世被加冕为拜占庭帝国皇帝,发誓要保护前皇帝罗马诺斯二世的两个儿子,他们已经加冕为同帝.
de: Nikephoros II Phokas is crowned emperor of the Byzantine Empire, swearing to protect the two sons of the previous emperor Romanos II, who are already crowned co-emperors.

t: 奥托一世皇帝在罗马的圣彼得巴西利卡召集了一个议会. 教宗约翰十二世被废黜,罪名是反对奥托的武装…
te: Emperor Otto I calls a council at St. Peter's Basilica in Rome. Pope John XII is deposed on charges of an armed rebelli…
dz: 罗马的锡诺德:奥托一世皇帝在罗马的圣彼得巴西利卡召集了一个议会. 教宗约翰十二世被废黜,罪名是反对奥托的武装叛乱.
de: Synod of Rome: Emperor Otto I calls a council at St. Peter's Basilica in Rome. Pope John XII is deposed on charges of an armed rebellion against Otto.

t: 外行教宗原教宗被选为教皇并取名"利奥八世"(Leo VIII),于12月6日授勋后被册封.
te: The lay papal protonotary is elected pope and takes the name Leo VIII, being consecrated on 6 December after ordination.
dz: 外行教宗原教宗被选为教皇并取名"利奥八世"(Leo VIII),于12月6日授勋后被册封.
de: The lay papal protonotary is elected pope and takes the name Leo VIII, being consecrated on 6 December after ordination.
